v.storypage.preview.text: First, read each word to your grown-up. Take your time.

v.storypage.echo.text: I will read a sentence, and then you read it back to me.

v.storypage.read.text: Now read the story page out loud. Look closely at each part of every long word.

v.storypage.restoring.text: Look! The torn page is coming back together.

v.storypage.pass.text: The page is whole again, apprentice. You read it with care. Well done.

v.storypage.growth.text: A mistake means a pattern we haven't practiced enough yet. This page will be ready next time.
